eps.t: The Noel Edmonds Golden Easter Egg Awards
eps.d: Hosted by Noel Edmonds Introduced by Mike Smith Noel's back with a special seasonal edition of the Golden Egg Awards for a celebration of out-takes, foul-ups, slips, trips and blunders. You've seen the BAFTAs and Oscars, now for the most prestigious event in the awards calendar.

Hosted by Noel Edmonds Introduced by Mike Smith The occasion of the year - The 1986 Golden Egg Award Ceremony - celebrates in great style all the fluffs, bloops and blunders made over the past year's broadcasting. Who will receive the coveted Fellowship of the Golden Egg this year?

Noel Edmonds returns with a new, live series, action-packed with dare devil stunts, star interviews, the best in music and visits to exotic locations from Beverly Hills to just west of Bournemouth. The Hit Squad will be back in action with its hidden camera, there will be out-takes and funny moments from television throughout the world, and more intrepid volunteers will be braving the challenges…

In this week's edition, live from the Santa Pod Raceway, an attempt is made to break the world long distance car jumping record, which currently stands at 232 ft. Also featured are ' Give it a whirl ', ' The Golden Egg Awards ', 'The Noel Edmonds Hit Squad' and guests from the world of pop music.
This week a rather unusual celebrity ' Grand Prix ' and a visit to Chessington Circus. The Hit Squad will be in the south of England once again and members of the public will Give it a Whirl.

During this live programme Leo Sayer and David Boyce will attempt to break the existing record for the fastest journey between the centre of Paris and the centre of London. The Marble Arch/Arc de Triomphe record has stood since 1959 at 40 minutes 40 seconds, will it be broken tonight?

This week the show once again features the ' Golden Egg' Awards. Those naughty people from the ' Hit Squad' will be up to their tricks again and another member of the public gets a chance to ' Give it a Whirl' plus two international stars from the world of pop music.

This week the show visits East Anglia for an action-packed outside broadcast. In the studio Noel presents the ' Golden Egg' awards and another member of the public gets a chance to ' Give it a Whirl'. The ' Hit Squad ' surprises the unsuspecting public and there are guests from the world of pop.

Noel presents his usual live, fast-moving line-up. In the studio he'll be joined by guests from the world of pop, and honouring stars of stage and screen with the greatly coveted ' Golden Egg Awards'. The Hit Squad ' will be at large up and down the country and another of Noel's intrepid viewers will be getting the chance to ' Give it a Whirl'.

Noel presents his usual live, fast-moving line-up. In the studio he is joined by guests from the world of pop music and some surprise guests from ' Down Under'. The ' Hit Squad' are at large up and down the country and another of Noel's intrepid viewers gets the chance to ' Give it a Whirl

Among Noel's guests live in the studio this week are Oliva Newton-John and Madness, and the 'Hit Squad' will be up to their usual naughty tricks up and down the country. Noel presents the 'Golden Egg Awards' featuring more funny moments from television around the world and the 'Give it a Whirl' contestants are given support and encouragement by Sandra Dickinson and Murray Walker.

This week the show once again features the ' Golden Egg' awards. Those naughty people from the 'Hit Squad' will be up to their tricks again and another member of the public gets a chance to ' Give it a Whirl '.

Noel's special guests this week are Jimmy Tarbuck , Little and Large and Status Quo. Also included in the show are 'The Golden Egg Awards', the 'Hit Squad' and another member of the public gets a chance to ' Give it a Whirl'.

This week the show has a wintry feeling as a member of the public joins the celebrities on the ski slopes. In the warmth of the studio Noel introduces more contenders for the 'Golden Egg Awards' and the 'Hit Squad once again briefly changes the course of some viewers' lives.

In this week's live show Noel once again presents the highly acclaimed ' Golden Egg Awards '. Another member of the public gets the chance to fulfil an unconventional ambition in ' Give it a Whirl' and Noel is joined in the studio by some surprise guests.
Joining Noel for his live show are Elton John and Frankie Howerd
The last in the series starring Noel Edmonds A special end of series edition with special guests and surprises and featuring this year's Whirly Wheelers.

A special edition featuring the Cross Channel Extravaganza live from the Straits of Dover. Attempts will be made to break at least a dozen existing cross-channel records. Featuring Cliff Michelmore Murray Walker Suzanne Dando and a special guest from the world of pop music

This week's show features The Golden Egg Awards, those naughty people from the Hit Squad who will be up to their tncks again, and a member of the public gets a chance to sink or swim with Give It A Whirl.
This week features Noel's special guests from America Sister Sledge, together with The Golden Egg Award, the infamous Hit Squad, and another member of the public will be flying high this week.
On this week's show noel welcomes special guest Tina Turner. Give it a Whirl goes on safari, The Hit Squad file is reopened, and a member of the audience gets a nasty shock.

Tonight's special guests are Culture Club. This week's Whirly Wheelers are taken for a ride in a most surprising way; The Hit Squad have been in action in the west country; and more foul-ups with The Golden Egg Awards.
This week the show goes racing to Brighton. The Golden Egg Awards present some worldwide goofs and blunders, and The Hit Squad Team will be up to their naughty tricks again.

This week Noel's special guests from America are The Everly Brothers. Outside Broadcast cameras will be in Blackpool with John Inman together with Give it A Whirl, The Golden Egg Awards and the Hit Squad.

This week the show visits the circus to meet the tap-dancing rhino and the juggling hamster. The Golden Egg Awards present more television foul-ups from all over the world, and one or two other places.
Starring Noel Edmonds with his guests Duran Duran This week the emphasis is on motor racing and the Hit Squad has been at work in the south west of England.
This week the Hit Squad surprises an unsuspecting member of the audience. Noel introduces more foul-ups from all over the world, and the live OB comes from the bonfire party at Beaulieu in Hampshire.

This week's live show features pop music and the Hit Squad who'll be at large up and down the country. Another of Noel's intrepid viewers will get the chance to Give it a Whirl, and in tonight's OB Mike Smith returns to the 'good old days'.
This week Noel presents the finals of Mr Puniverse 1984; a member of the public treads the slippery slope of success and the music is provided by the Moody Blues.

Noel will be joined by guests from the world of pop music. The International Hit Squad is at work, and Mike Smith presents an outside broadcast where a member of the public takes part in one of the most exciting Whirly Wheel stunts.

Tonight Mike Smith brings a Romany flavour to the programme. A member of the public makes a goat of himself, and the Golden Egg awards present more foul-ups from all over the world. The Hit Squad have been at work in the south of England and the music comes from the Thompson Twins.

Mike Smith introduces the live outside broadcast this week, where a member of the public has a chance to star in an Aqua Spectacular. In the studio, Noel presents the finals of Poseur of the Year, together with the Golden Egg Awards, the Hit Squad and music from Frankie Goes to Hollywood.
Tonight's show is full of magic, mystery and illusion. Mike Smith is with the outside broadcast cameras in a very tricky situation, and Noel presents more Golden Egg Awards together with the hits.

From the top of British Telecom Tower, Noel Edmonds presents a live outside broadcast, wishing the United Kingdom a happy Christmas from 625 feet above London. He is joined by a host of star guests for a morning of comedy, music, daredevil stunts and highlights of this year's television.

In the first of a new series Noel returns with an action-packed edition featuring comedy, pop music and excitement. This includes some of your favourite items together with some brand new features. The Hit Squad has been at work during the summer and promises a few surprises for unsuspecting viewers.

A plucky viewer performs one of the most exciting daredevil stunts on the Whirly Wheel, the first heat of the Lawnmower Grand Prix zooms into action, and those cheeky tricksters from the Hit Squad are back with more fun and laughter.

Tonight an intrepid member of the public takes to the air in one of the most spectacular aerobatic displays ever seen on British television. The Golden Egg Awards feature more TV blunders and Home Videos. And the Hit Squad has been operating in the south of England.

An intrepid Whirly Wheeler joins the OB cameras at the Lawn Prix circuit for his Give it a Whirl challenge and the finals of the Lawn Mower Prix. Together with the Golden Egg Awards, the Hit Squad and a special guest star from the world of pop music.

In this week's show music from special guest stars Elton John and Arcadia featuring Simon Le Bon and Nick Rhodes Give it a Whirl presents ski-jumping with a difference, and the Hit Squad and the Golden Egg Awards have a political theme.

In tonight's show the outside broadcast cameras visit Blackpool, where a daring Whirly Wheeler has his 'head in the clouds'. The Hit Squad visits the south of England and a member of the audience has a nasty surprise. The programme features the Golden Egg Awards with foul-ups, goofs and blunders plus viewers' home videos, and the search for Britain's biggest 'suck and blow'.
Featuring the Golden Egg Awards, the Hit Squad, the Winners of the Week and a star guest from the world of pop music. Plus a daring Whirly Wheeler who helps the show 'go with a bang'.

This week features foul-ups, goofs and blunders from film and television in the Golden Egg Awards, and a viewer has a chance to ride the Globe of Death. The Hit Squad are out and about in the south of England and Noel presents more Winners of the Week.
The outside broadcast cameras are out and about with Mike Smith somewhere in the Midlands! The regional heats for Mr Puniverse are held and the Hit Squad team surprise more unsuspecting viewers.

Noel and Mike are joined by special guest star Paul McCartney presenting his new release 'Spies like us'. The outside broadcast cameras are out and about somewhere in the Midlands. Tonight features the finals of the 1985 Mr Puniverse competition. The Hit Squad team surprise more unsuspecting viewers.

This week the outside broadcast cameras visit one of London's top night-spots where an intrepid Whirly Wheeler rides the Sphere of Fear. A member of the public has a surprising encounter with a Japanese businessman and Noel presents the Stars of the Week and the Golden Egg Awards.

Tonight Mike Smith is with the outside broadcast cameras at Aldershot race track for the Great EggChallenge and a Grand Prix with a difference. the Hit squad is up to more tricks and the Eggcademy presents more Golden Eggs.

Tonight the outside broadcast cameras are at a secret location in the north of Scotland where this week's Whirly Wheeler attempts one of the most daring and exciting challenges ever featured in the series.
An intrepid Whirly Wheeler takes part in a high-wire stunt at a secret location. The Hit Squad team have more fun and Noel presents the Golden Egg Awards.

From the top of London's British Telecom Tower, Noel Edmonds presents a live outside broadcast uniting families and friends throughout the world. British relief workers in Africa are linked with their families in Britain by the first live television satellite broadcast from the Sudan. Mike Smith goes out and about with the BBCtv helicopter camera.

The first show in 1986 takes the Whirly Wheeler for a visit to the circus as part of the Give it a Whirl challenge. The Hit Squad team are still in action and there are more fun-packed out-takes and blunders with the Golden Egg Awards.
This week holds all the usual antics from the Hit Squad, Mike Sm

This week's show brings high tension when intrepid Whirly Wheelers perform from a great height and undertake a very delicate manoeuvre. This year's regional heats for Mr Poseur begin, plus all the usual fun and games with the Hit Squad and the Golden Egg Awards.

Mike Smith and the OB cameras are in Lympstone this week with the Royal Marines and the Whirly Wheel challenge by land, by sea. There are more Poseur heats leading to the grand finals, the Hit Squad team shock and amuse the unsuspecting public, and Golden Egg Awards are presented for more blunders and mistakes.

Join Noel and Mike for another zany fun-packed show. Will the Y-front jumping record be broken? Will your boyfriend win this week's heat of the Mr Poseur 1986 competition? And will this week's Whirly Wheeler withstand the extremes of ice and fire? All this, plus the Hit Squad and the Golden Egg Awards.
The Hit Squad is in operation. Mike Smith is with the outside broadcast cameras at a secret location. More area finals of the Mr Poseur competition and Noel presents the Golden Egg Awards.
This week the search is on to find Mr Poseur 1986. The intrepid Whirly Wheeler braves a challenge which includes a helicopter and a piano! And Noel presents the Golden Egg Awards.

The last programme of the present series is an all winners show. Can anyone beat the Y-front pants jumping record? Who owns the fastest lawnmower and how many people can get into a supermarket trolley? Noel presents the final Golden Egg Awards and the daring Whirly Wheeler goes high into orbit.

Noel Edmonds and Mike Smith return to the screen to host a live Hit Squad special. Who will be the victims tonight? The Hit Squad team have been in operation for the past four years and tonight they celebrate this very special occasion. Featuring delightful examples of childish behaviour and British reserve. Keep watching, particularly over your shoulder - you never know where they'll strike next.

eps.t: Episode 2: Give it a Whirl Special
eps.d: Tonight Noel Edmonds and Mike Smith host a Give it a Whirl special. In the past four years over 60 enthusiastic amateurs have performed some of the most daring feats ever seen on British TV. Tonight's special honours these Whirly Wheelers.
The 1986 Golden Egg Awards celebrate in great style the fluffs, bloops and blunders made over the past year's broadcasting.

In this, the first of a new live series, Noel presents many brand new features. Have you got a Claim to Fame? Could you accept the Golden Gauntlet challenge and beat the Flushbusters? Telephone lines are open from 5.0 pm to 90 pm on [number removed]. The Hit Squad and Golden Egg Awards are back, and Mike Smith takes a whirly wheeler on a dramatic cable-car rescue in Where an Eagle Dares.

In this week's live show Noel Presents more aspiring television stars in Claim to Fame and more viewers Prepared to take up the Golden Gauntlet challenge. The telephone lines are open from 5 pm to 9 pm on [number removed]for entrants to both these items. Mike Smith takes an intrepid whirly wheeler through the Wookey Hole caves in Raiders of the Lost Egg.

In this week's live show Noel presents more viewers taking up the Golden Gauntlet challenges and those laying a Claim to Fame. The telephone lines are open from 5.0 pm to 9.0 pm on [number removed]for entrants to these items. This week's telephone password is 'Oh, Rodney, you're such a plonker!', so stand by for Noel's live phone call.

In this week's live show Mike Smith lets the whirly wheeler shoot the rapids, and he issues Smitty's Challenge to any viewer silly enough to take it up. Noel presents more silliness in Claim to Fame, and introduces more viewers prepared to take up his Golden Gauntlet challenges. The telephone lines are open from 5.0 pm to 9.0 pm on [number removed], for entrants to these items.

In the live show our whirly wheeler meets up with one of Britain's top boxers Frank Bruno for a three-round contest. More viewers take up the Golden Gauntlet challenge and reveal their Claim to Fame. The telephone lines are open from 5.0 pm to 9.0 pm on [number removed] for entrants to these items.

In this week's live show the whirly wheeler makes a life-saving rescue in the North Sea; more viewers reveal their Claim to Fame and take up the Golden Gauntlet challenge. The telephone lines are open from 5.0 pm to 8.0 pm on [number removed]for entrants to these items. The Golden Egg Awards return, together with the Hit Squad. This week's password is: 'Oh Rodney, you're such a plonker!'
